outcome: rate of in utero pH (pHiu) use
number of pHiu performed per patient
cohort: 1515 patients in labor with a vaginal delivery agreement, a fetus in cephalic presentation and no contraindication to perform a pHiu at a university maternity hospital in Lille.
finding: Implementation of team training and fetal scalp pacing led to a decrease in pHiu use without increasing neonatal acidosis, instrumental deliveries, or cesarean sections.
